claim_updates.reason: Unchanged at HYPOTHESIS: this packet licenses no inference about C-WEB-DYNAMICS in either direction, and it does not license the thread retirement that request.json director_mandate allocation.action = PIVOT made conditional. Chain of record: producer result.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE; independent audit.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID producer_claim_supported=false with 14 required_fixes, 15 validity_findings, 5 baseline_findings. The Director CONFIRMS the producer's disposition and gate arithmetic (G0 FAIL / G1 PASS / G2 FAIL / G3 FAIL recompute exactly from the durable artifacts) and REJECTS the producer's interpretation (report.md section 4.1 'the calibration experiment correctly falsifies the instrument', section 5 'a valid scientific negative at the instrument level' and 'the thread is RETIRED'). Four independent reasons, each verified by the Director in the exact executed code: (1) The primary statistic never read the treatment. compute_conditional_entropy (execute_calibration_v3.py:199-213) skips any stratum absent from K_per_stratum at line 207, K_per_stratum is keyed by the C stratum alone (get_K_per_stratum, lines 351-355) while the R-conditioned term is keyed by (C, R) (CR_key_fn, line 268), so 0 of 468 (C,R) cells resolve and H(S_next|C,R) is identically 0.0 for every channel and bank. M_OBS_CMI_bits is therefore definitionally H(S_next|C) - 0. (2) The minimum attainable p-value is 1.0 for any dataset: p_raw = (1 + n_exceed)/(n_perms + 1) at lines 295-296 with n_exceed = 1000 under an R-invariant statistic, giving 1001/1001 = 1.0. M_P_RAW and M_P_BONF = 1.0 on all 8 (bank, channel) cells in permutation_results.json is a structural floor, not an empirical outcome, so G2's p_bonf < 0.01 was mathematically unreachable. Corroborated on a third, independent data path: results.pkl iid_metrics obs_cmi 0.776035 == perm_mean 0.776035. (3) Two of the three failing gates were unsatisfiable by construction, so the CALIBRATED branch of the frozen decision_rule was unreachable before execution and this was not a discriminating test. G3: R is a deterministic function of (regime, cur_state, action) truncated to a 4-char hash (lines 84-119), pinning MI(R;latent) at H(latent) = log2(5) = 2.3219 bits against a required < 0.9 (measured 2.2593-2.2707). G2: mean I(next;regime|s,a) = 0.019899 bits (max 0.065026 over the 25 (s,a) cells) yields an attainable gap of 0.013929 bits on average and 0.045518 bits at the best single cell, against a required 0.05; and G2 is additionally confounded, because the banks are not matched in R relabel noise rate (executed Null 0.40/0.35, Positive 0.30/0.25, lines 81 and 112) so the nuisance mismatch alone contributes 0.10 x 0.620386 = 0.062039 bits, 4.5x the planted signal and above the threshold on its own. (4) G1, the null-validity leg, has zero dynamic range: because the statistic is R-invariant, any input whatsoever returns p_bonf = 1.0 and BC = 0, so G1 cannot fail and its PASS demonstrates nothing about the instrument's ability to identify a null. The mandate's trigger was 'the banks do not both return the correct verdict' in a design capable of returning both correct verdicts; this design was not, so firing the retirement would convert a rigged gate into a false negative. A failure to pass a gate that cannot be passed is not a falsification. Registry status for C-WEB-DYNAMICS stays HYPOTHESIS (research/claims/registry.json sha256 3511a788..., next_gate 'orthogonal falsifiable programs on effect factorization, barriers, timescales, geometry, multiscale dynamics or other measurable mechanisms') and codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim C-WEB-DYNAMICS is already HYPOTHESIS from EXP-PHYSICS-36104718112 (79 events: 70 HYPOTHESIS, 6 EXPERIMENTAL, 3 MEASUREMENT_INVALID), so this event is a retention-plus-new-adverse-evidence event and not a status change. No effect size, no support, no refutation, no PARK, no retirement.

Retention-plus-new-evidence event, not an advance. C-MEAS-VALID is a frozen claim_id of this packet (spec.json claim_ids = ['C-WEB-DYNAMICS', 'C-MEAS-VALID']) and is adjudicated on its own evidence. It is already MEASUREMENT_INVALID in codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim (EXP-PRODUCT-36272385776), and nothing here changes that direction; the new adverse evidence is recorded so that the next designer does not treat a control set as discriminating by assumption. This packet is a direct, code-and-artifact verified instance of the exact failure the claim names (registry next_gate 'writable/auth/session/drift controls must produce discriminating positive and null outcomes'): (1) the null control B-INDEPENDENT-REGIME-NULL is affirmatively non-discriminating, returning p_bonf 1.0 and BC -3.33e-16 on all four R for any input, because the statistic is R-invariant, so its G1 PASS carries no validity information; (2) the positive control CTRL_POS_NONCOPY_REGIME is not a positive control in the sense gate G2 requires, because G2 is unsatisfiable (planted gap 0.013929 bits, best cell 0.045518 bits, versus 0.05 required) and confounded (0.062039-bit unmatched nuisance noise-rate difference); (3) gate G3's MI(R;latent) < 0.9 is unreachable for any R that is a deterministic function of cur_state, since MI is then pinned at H(latent) = 2.3219 bits; (4) the frozen required control B-HISTORY-MARKOV was never executed (result.json controls.B-HISTORY-MARKOV.observed = {}; the frozen artifact raw_transitions_history_baseline.json is absent), so the frozen design was not executed as written and no ceiling can be stated on how much of the 0.760601 / 0.813412 bits of H(S_next|C) is attributable to the 3-step history; (5) evidence integrity: the committed files labelled role=raw do not contain the measured treatment of the evaluation split, because run_permutation_test uses a shallow t.copy() (line 280) and writes into permuted[idx]['R'][R_channel] (line 288), which is the same dict as the source transition's, with serialisation after all metrics (lines 491-495), so 744/1920 (38.8%) Null and 256/1920 (13.3%) Positive TEST-row R cells differ from regenerated data while 0/4480 TRAIN cells differ; (6) undisclosed truncation: only 301/480 (62.7%) Null and 296/480 (61.7%) Positive TEST transitions enter the metric, dropped at line 206 and line 207 with no count reported. Scope: bounded to the physics calibration code path in research/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922/execute_calibration_v3.py. It does not touch the Runtime plain-HTTP localhost shared-WAL gate (EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580), does not bear on browser or CDP provisioning, and does not license any general statement about another lane's substrate. The undeclared clamp at line 271 (max(0.0, cmi)) is recorded as a latent hazard only: the audit verified it did not bind in this run and did not bind under a prereg-conformant repair of the key lookup (+0.694 to +0.732 bits), so it caused no reported number. next_question: Before any further C-WEB-DYNAMICS measurement, and before any re-run of this calibration: can the physics apparatus be CERTIFIED to read a treatment variable at all, by a pre-registered instrument-contract test in which instrument-blindness is a detectable positive event rather than a post-hoc discovery? Concretely, browser-free and inside research/physics: (a) a representation-sensitivity contract executed as a metamorphic test on the same code path and the same data, requiring both directions on the identical bank set - permuting the treatment within strata must leave the statistic bit-identical (an invariance property that today passes trivially and must keep passing), AND re-drawing the treatment through a channel whose MI to the target is measured and pre-registered before the gate is frozen must move the statistic by at least that channel's marginal-conditional information, with the minimum attainable permutation p proved to be strictly below 0.01. This requires that the R-conditioned term is actually evaluated: today K_per_stratum is keyed by the C stratum alone (execute_calibration_v3.py:351-355) while the conditional term is keyed by (C, R) (line 268) and is skipped by the line-207 guard, so 0 of 468 (C,R) cells resolve, H(S_next|C,R) is identically 0.0, and p_raw is floored at (1+1000)/(1000+1) = 1.0 for any dataset whatsoever; (b) an analytic null whose signature takes the representation as an argument and whose value provably changes when the representation is replaced by a matched independent relabel, replacing BOTH frozen forms - the spec digamma E[PMI] (spec.json measurement_validity[1], executed at lines 246-248, whose scale is set by the arbitrary concentration alpha = 1/K, giving -1.202246 / +3.125839 / +10.339314 / +14.667400 / +18.995485 bits at N_c = 3 for K = 1..5) and the prereg gammaln Dirichlet-Multinomial log-marginal form (prereg.md section 4.4) - since neither is an expectation of the statistic actually nulled, and the current G0 is bit-identical across all four R channels by construction; (c) only if (a) and (b) hold, ONE re-designed calibration pair whose power is computed BEFORE freezing, with the planted regime gap measured and shown to exceed the decision threshold (today mean I(next;regime|s,a) = 0.019899 bits yields at most 0.013929 bits of gap, 0.045518 bits at the best single cell, against a required 0.05), the two banks matched in the R relabel noise rate (today 0.40/0.35 versus 0.30/0.25 contributes 0.062039 bits of spurious gap, 4.5x the planted signal), a non-degenerate state space (S_next must range over at least 16 states, not 5, since 219 of 436 Null TRAIN strata sit at K = 1 with alpha = 1), an R channel that is not a deterministic function of cur_state (MI(R;latent) < 0.9 is unreachable for any copy channel, since MI is pinned at H(latent) = 2.3219 bits), and the frozen B-HISTORY-MARKOV control actually executed. This experiment cannot be re-run or repaired under the existing freeze (prereg.md section 13 No-Drift Clause; audit required_fixes[13]), and a failure of (a) or (b) is a code-level falsifier of the estimator, not a falsification of C-WEB-DYNAMICS. A pointwise conditional-PMI sweep on the current synthetic-FSM facade must not be repeated, and a third calibration that only swaps the estimator formula while leaving the design, the planted effect size and the nuisance matching unaddressed must not be repeated either. If the Global Research Director declines to fund an instrument-certification cycle, the lane should move to a materially orthogonal measurable object from the C-WEB-DYNAMICS registry next_gate (effect factorization, barriers, timescales/relaxation, geometry, multiscale dynamics) rather than continue to re-run the predictive-accuracy paradigm; but the non-Markovian relaxation-time object - whether H(S_{t+k} | S_t, URL_t, regime-history) decays more slowly than a matched order-(k-1) Markov null for k >= 2 on a locally served application with a server-side ground-truth transition log - must not be measured with an uncertified statistic.
reason: Bounded decision: MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the frozen question, with the producer's disposition confirmed and the producer's interpretation rejected, and with the mandate's thread-retirement trigger explicitly NOT fired. Chain of record: RAW EVIDENCE (permutation_results.json, analytic_null_stats.json, results.pkl, raw_transitions_{null_bank,positive_bank,iid_null}.json) -> OBSERVATION (result.json metrics/controls, status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome NOT_APPLICABLE) -> DERIVED MEASUREMENT (gates G0 FAIL / G1 PASS / G2 FAIL / G3 FAIL; obs_cmi 0.8134123302570013 Null and 0.7606006392528275 Positive, each equal to perm_mean to 4e-16; analytic_mean 5.092262718862476 Null and 3.8095066467026184 Positive, bit-identical across all four R) -> INTERPRETATION (report.md sections 4.1 and 5: instrument falsified, paradigm not instrumented, thread retired) -> AUDIT FINDING (audit.json status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false, V1/V2/V5 decisive) -> DECISION (this verdict). There is no numerical dispute: the audit reproduced every producer gate verdict and every per-cell value from the durable artifacts, and the Director independently confirmed the decisive code paths. The dispute is about license, and the audit and the Director resolve it against the producer. Why no license runs in either direction: the executed statistic is definitionally H(S_next|C) because the R-conditioned term is never evaluated (verified at execute_calibration_v3.py:199-213, 266-271, 351-355), which floors p_raw at 1.0 for any dataset and makes G1 unfailable, G2's p-leg unreachable, and G0 structurally unsatisfiable; and the two remaining failing gates were unsatisfiable by construction before execution (G3 because R is a deterministic function of cur_state, pinning MI(R;latent) at H(latent) = 2.3219 bits; G2 because the planted regime information supports at most 0.013929 bits of gap against a 0.05 requirement, and is swamped by a 0.062039-bit unmatched nuisance noise-rate mismatch). A design whose CALIBRATED branch cannot be reached cannot certify an instrument, and equally cannot refute one. Three further record-level findings bound what may be carried forward: result.json.metrics is not a faithful serialisation of the producer's own durable artifacts (M_OBS_CMI_bits, M_PERM_MEAN_bits, M_ANALYTIC_STD_bits, M_PERM_STD_bits and M_H_Snext_given_C_bits are reported 0.0 against artifact values 0.813412 / 0.760601, 1.3303196591223716 / 1.30279118139431, 3.3306690738754696e-16 and 0.813412 / 0.760601), so the packet's statement that the positive bank shows 'zero detectable signal' must not be inherited - the instrument registered 0.76-0.81 bits of conditional mutual information that it could not separate from a permutation null that is itself identical to the observation; the files labelled role=raw carry permuted R values on 38.8% / 13.3% of TEST rows and are derived, not raw; and a frozen required control (B-HISTORY-MARKOV) was never executed. One bounded chain finding added by the Director and not present in audit.json: provenance.json frozen_inputs.freeze.json records b2317b7fe2f1d5acea06946429208cc9cca62e46250ce65c73aef4b994125082, which is the PARENT packet's freeze.json digest, whereas this packet's freeze.json is fa0374d9193e3153f61819bfc002e49e9537e94f1c84f25871611ce55ecf27bb. The three inputs the freeze actually protects - request.json c8934e16..., spec.json 09c8d285..., prereg.md 04aef753... - are verified unmodified, so this is a copied-digest provenance error, not a freeze violation, and it does not alter any finding. Program-level consequence the Director records explicitly: the physics apparatus has now failed twice in succession to demonstrate that it can read its own treatment variable (this packet's V1 and the parent packet's representation-invariant analytic), and in both cases the failure was discovered post hoc rather than caught by a pre-registered instrument-contract test. That pattern is mechanical, not scientific, and the correct response is to make the instrument's representation-sensitivity a pre-registered, cheaply falsifiable property of the code rather than to attempt a third synthetic-bank calibration under a new formula. This verdict therefore does not authorize immediate chaining: the next step is a NEW physics experiment and Physics may not self-authorize child experiments (AGENTS.md global direction discipline), so a Global Research Director director_mandate is required, and the current freeze is spent per prereg.md section 13. No product promotion: physics lane, no product code, audit status is MEASUREMENT_INVALID and not PASS. C-WEB-DYNAMICS stays HYPOTHESIS and the domain remains open.
